Package neupaths.api

Class EventCell

java.lang.Object
neupaths.api.Cell
neupaths.api.EventCell
public class EventCell extends Cell
Processes NeuPaths event stimuli. This cell will output event data to a PrintStream or pass it to a specialization of the EventActivator class.

  • Constructor Details

    • EventCell

      public EventCell(String name, String synapseName, String outputFileName, byte[] cryptoKey)
      Creates a new EventCell object that spools event data to a file. The cell subscribes to event stimuli on the same domain as the synapse.
      Parameters:
      name - The cell's name at runtime. This name should be unique across the entire cell system.
      synapseName - The synapse this cell listens on or connects to.
      outputFileName - The path/name of the output file for event data.
      cryptoKey - The stimulus encryption key. Specify null to disable encryption using a user-specified key. If disabled, the stimuli will still be encrypted as part of NeuPaths protocol encryption.

    • EventCell

      public EventCell(String name, String synapseName, PrintStream spooler, byte[] cryptoKey)
      Creates a new EventCell object that uses a PrintStream for output of event data. The cell subscribes to event stimuli on the same domain as the synapse.
      Parameters:
      name - The cell's name at runtime. This name should be unique across the entire cell system.
      synapseName - The synapse this cell listens on or connects to.
      spooler - The PrintStream object that will output event data (e.g. System.out).
      cryptoKey - The stimulus encryption key. Specify null to disable encryption using a user-specified key. If disabled, the stimuli will still be encrypted as part of NeuPaths protocol encryption.

    • EventCell

      public EventCell(String name, PropertySet properties, String synapseName, EventActivator activator, byte[] cryptoKey)
      Creates a new EventCell object that uses a specialization of the EventActivator class.
      Parameters:
      name - The cell's name at runtime. This name should be unique across the entire cell system.
      properties - A dictionary of named properties.
      synapseName - The synapse this cell listens on or connects to.
      activator - A specialization of the EventActivator class. It is the user's responsibility to provide a valid domain to the activator constructor.
      cryptoKey - The stimulus encryption key. Specify null to disable encryption using a user-specified key. If disabled, the stimuli will still be encrypted as part of NeuPaths protocol encryption.
